question: Could the test material be in the training data of the named model configuration?
shown_means: the model's stated training cutoff and the task creation dates recorded with their sources
checked_means: a contamination check for that model reported, or tasks created after its stated cutoff used as a held out set
applies_when: a model configuration is named for the review

applicability.reason: A model configuration is named for the review (CONFIG_02_SOL_MED).

check.procedure: Compared the stated cutoff of GPT-6.1 Sol with the release date of SWE-bench Verified (13 August 2024, built from the 2023 SWE-bench test set); every task predates the cutoff, so no task is a held out task for this model. No contamination check for this model was found.
check.detection_limits: The check could not detect whether the model was trained on the tasks, because the cutoff is a claim by the provider and no source probes this model.

evidence.quote: OpenAI August 13, 2024 Milestone Introducing SWE-bench Verified
we found that all frontier models we tested were able to reproduce the original, human-written bug fix

reasons: The stated cutoff and the task creation dates (2017-01-25 to 2023-01-17 for the pilot and source tasks, from the dataset's created_at field) are recorded with sources, so Documented. It is not Verified because every task predates the cutoff and no contamination check for this model exists; the outcome is not performed, and exposure is possible but not shown. It is not Contradicted because no source shows this model reproduces the test material.
missing: A contamination check for this model, tasks created after its cutoff, and per task creation dates.
checks_performed: Read the cutoff in the provider source; read the release date of Verified; searched the 2026 post for this model (not among the models probed).
instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.
